mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence, model_turn, scheduler_version, next_segment_sequence, state, expected_members, completed_members, recovery_generation, ready_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND plan_generation = #{planGeneration} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND node_attempt = #{nodeAttempt} AND segment_sequence = #{segmentSequence} AND model_turn = #{modelTurn}

SELECT id, run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence, model_turn, scheduler_version, next_segment_sequence, state, expected_members, completed_members, recovery_generation, ready_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, dispatch_proof_json::text AS dispatch_proof_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY member_seq

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, dispatch_proof_json::text AS dispatch_proof_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND external_operation_id = #{externalOperationId}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, dispatch_proof_json::text AS dispatch_proof_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, dispatch_proof_json::text AS dispatch_proof_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE state = 'RUNNING' AND next_poll_at IS NOT NULL AND next_poll_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_poll_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, recovery_generation, state, next_visible_at, consumed_at, consumed_by, close_reason, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY recovery_generation

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, recovery_generation, state, next_visible_at, consumed_at, consumed_by, close_reason, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification WHERE id = #{notificationId}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, recovery_generation, state, next_visible_at, consumed_at, consumed_by, close_reason, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification WHERE state = 'WAITING' AND next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_visible_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification SET state = 'CLOSED', close_reason = #{reason}, closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{notificationId} AND state = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.run_control_version FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} AND g.run_id = r.id -- 归属这一段的那条工作项也要对上：只核对组号时，计划推进或换段之后 -- 旧成员仍能把旧组推进成齐备，接着放出已经作废的下一段。 JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi ON wi.run_id = g.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = g.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = g.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = g.segment_sequence WHERE r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND r.plan_generation = #{planGeneration} AND r.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} -- 上下文版本是挂起那一刻这一段的上下文：对不上说明这一段已经不属于这条链了。 AND wi.context_version = #{contextVersion} AND wi.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} FOR UPDATE OF r ), member_done AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = #{memberState}::varchar, result_ref_json = CAST(#{resultRefJson} AS jsonb), external_operation_id = COALESCE(m.external_operation_id, #{externalOperationId}::varchar), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.member_identity = #{memberIdentity} -- 外部作业身份必须逐字对上，包括「两边都是空」这一种： -- 允许空值覆盖会把「不是这次作业的结果」也算成它的结果。 AND ((m.external_operation_id IS NULL AND #{externalOperationId}::varchar IS NULL) OR m.external_operation_id = #{externalOperationId}::varchar) AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING m.id, m.group_id, m.member_seq, m.state ), -- 完成数和齐备状态必须在同一次 UPDATE 里写完。同一语句里对这一行再 UPDATE -- 一次时，后一次按原行快照写 READY，完成数仍是 0，齐备约束会拒收整句，成员也回滚。 group_bumped AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET completed_members = g.completed_members + CASE WHEN #{memberState}::varchar IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, state = CASE WHEN g.completed_members + CASE WHEN #{memberState}::varchar IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = g.expected_members THEN 'READY' ELSE g.state END, recovery_generation = CASE WHEN g.completed_members + CASE WHEN #{memberState}::varchar IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = g.expected_members THEN g.recovery_generation + 1 ELSE g.recovery_generation END, ready_at = CASE WHEN g.completed_members + CASE WHEN #{memberState}::varchar IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = g.expected_members THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE g.ready_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM member_done d WHERE g.id = d.group_id AND g.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.completed_members, g.expected_members, g.recovery_generation, g.state ), group_ready AS ( SELECT b.id, b.run_id, b.recovery_generation FROM group_bumped b WHERE b.state = 'READY' ), notification_written AS ( INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification (group_id, run_id, recovery_generation, state, next_visible_at) SELECT r.id, r.run_id, r.recovery_generation, 'WAITING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_ready r ON CONFLICT (group_id, recovery_generation) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT id FROM member_done), (SELECT id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity}) ) AS member_id, (SELECT member_seq FROM member_done) AS member_seq, COALESCE( (SELECT state FROM member_done), (SELECT state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity}) ) AS member_state, (SELECT id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) AS group_id, COALESCE( (SELECT 'READY' FROM group_ready), (SELECT state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS group_state, COALESCE( (SELECT completed_members FROM group_bumped), (SELECT completed_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS completed_members, COALESCE( (SELECT expected_members FROM group_bumped), (SELECT expected_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS expected_members, (SELECT recovery_generation FROM group_ready) AS recovery_generation, -- 通知编号要返回真实主键：常量 1 只在空库第一条上碰巧是对的， -- 第二条会把错误编号交给恢复消费，真正的通知永远留在等待态。 (SELECT id FROM notification_written) AS notification_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM member_done) AS written_members

WITH run_fence AS ( -- 先锁 Run 行，再动任何子行：这条语句自带一段「取消之后再补审计」的成员更新， -- 那段审计不挑 Run 的版本（版本已经变了才更需要留痕），但锁的顺序必须和其他写入一致， -- 否则同一张图上的并发写入会互相锁出死结。 SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.status, r.plan_generation AS run_plan_generation, r.run_control_version AS run_control_version FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} AND g.run_id = r.id FOR UPDATE OF r ), member_late AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'LATE', result_ref_json = COALESCE(m.result_ref_json, CAST(#{resultRefJson} AS jsonb)), external_operation_id = COALESCE(m.external_operation_id, #{externalOperationId}::varchar), finished_at = COALESCE(m.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.member_identity = #{memberIdentity} -- 外部作业身份逐字对上才算这个成员的结果；两边都是空也只在同一成员上成立。 AND ((m.external_operation_id IS NULL AND #{externalOperationId}::varchar IS NULL) OR m.external_operation_id = #{externalOperationId}::varchar) -- 已经落过终态的不再改：迟到结果只补审计，重复上报不许覆盖先到的那一份。 AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING m.id, m.group_id, m.member_seq, m.state ), group_stopped AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM member_late d, run_fence f WHERE g.id = d.group_id AND g.id = #{groupId} AND f.run_id = g.run_id AND g.state IN ('WAITING', 'READY') -- 停链要 Run 还在这一代执行：计划代际与控制版本都得对上。版本来不及对上的旧链 -- 由它自己的终结路径处理，这一条只留审计，不推进组、不碰分段。 AND f.status = 'EXECUTING' AND f.run_plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND f.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.plan_generation, g.node_id, g.node_attempt, g.next_segment_sequence ), siblings_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'CANCELED', finished_at = COALESCE(m.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE m.group_id = s.id AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') RETURNING 1 ), segment_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE wi.run_id = s.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = s.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = s.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = s.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = s.next_segment_sequence AND wi.state IN ('WAITING', 'RESUMABLE', 'RUNNABLE') RETURNING 1 ), notification_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE n.group_id = s.id AND n.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT id FROM member_late) AS member_id, (SELECT member_seq FROM member_late) AS member_seq, (SELECT state FROM member_late) AS member_state, (SELECT id FROM group_stopped) AS group_id, COALESCE( (SELECT 'CANCELED' FROM group_stopped), (SELECT state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS group_state, (SELECT completed_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) AS completed_members, (SELECT expected_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) AS expected_members, NULL::int AS recovery_generation, NULL::bigint AS notification_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM member_late) AS written_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM siblings_canceled) AS written_siblings

WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id, g.id AS group_id, g.recovery_generation FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n ON n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.run_id = r.id JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = n.group_id JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease l ON l.run_id = r.id AND l.owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId} AND l.fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND l.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE n.state = 'WAITING' AND n.next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND n.recovery_generation = g.recovery_generation AND g.state = 'READY' AND r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND r.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi WHERE wi.run_id = g.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = g.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = g.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = g.next_segment_sequence AND wi.state = 'WAITING' AND wi.run_control_version = r.run_control_version) FOR UPDATE OF r, n, l ), segment_promoted AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi SET state = 'RESUMABLE', runnable_since = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, next_visible_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM run_fence f WHERE wi.run_id = f.run_id AND wi.state = 'WAITING' -- 放行那一步自己也再核对一遍控制代际：这一段必须属于 Run 当前的控制版本。 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = f.run_id AND r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.run_control_version = wi.run_control_version) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g WHERE g.id = f.group_id AND wi.plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = g.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = g.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = g.next_segment_sequence) RETURNING wi.run_id, wi.plan_generation, wi.node_id, wi.node_attempt, wi.segment_sequence, f.group_id AS group_id ), group_resumed AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'RESUMED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM segment_promoted p WHERE g.id = p.group_id AND g.state = 'READY' RETURNING g.id AS group_id ), notification_consumed AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, consumed_by = #{dispatcherId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_resumed r WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.group_id = r.group_id AND n.state = 'WAITING' -- 组号要与通知主键一起返回：主查询要按它回报这次消费放行的是哪条链， -- 只返回主键的话主查询点不到 group_id 这一列。 RETURNING n.id, n.group_id ), -- 这一条通知现在为什么取不走：与上面的判断用同一份库状态，从最前面的条件开始逐条问， -- 第一个不成立的就是原因。全部成立时原因为空——那说明这次消费本该成功。 diagnosis AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN n.state <> 'WAITING' THEN 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_WAITING' WHEN n.next_visible_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_DUE' WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 'RUN_MISSING' WHEN g.id IS NULL THEN 'GROUP_MISSING' WHEN n.recovery_generation <> g.recovery_generation THEN 'GENERATION_STALE' WHEN g.state = 'CANCELED' THEN 'GROUP_CANCELED' WHEN g.state = 'RESUMED' THEN 'GROUP_ALREADY_RESUMED' WHEN g.state <> 'READY' THEN 'GROUP_NOT_READY' WHEN r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED', 'PARTIAL') THEN 'RUN_TERMINAL' WHEN r.status = 'CANCELING' THEN 'RUN_CANCELING' WHEN r.status <> 'EXECUTING' THEN 'RUN_NOT_EXECUTING' WHEN r.plan_generation <> g.plan_generation THEN 'PLAN_GENERATION_STALE' WHEN r.run_control_version <> #{runControlVersion} THEN 'RUN_CONTROL_VERSION_CHANGED' WHEN wi.id IS NULL THEN 'NEXT_SEGMENT_MISSING' WHEN wi.run_control_version <> r.run_control_version THEN 'SEGMENT_CONTROL_VERSION_STALE' WHEN wi.state IN ('RESUMABLE', 'RUNNABLE', 'CLAIMED', 'EXECUTING') THEN 'NEXT_SEGMENT_ACTIVE' WHEN wi.state <> 'WAITING' THEN 'NEXT_SEGMENT_TERMINAL' WHEN l.run_id IS NULL OR l.owner_instance_id <> #{ownerInstanceId} OR l.fencing_token <> #{fencingToken} OR l.expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'LEASE_NOT_OWNED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS rejection, CASE WHEN n.state <> 'WAITING' THEN n.state WHEN r.id IS NULL OR g.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN g.state = 'CANCELED' OR g.state = 'RESUMED' THEN g.state WHEN r.status <> 'EXECUTING' THEN r.status WHEN wi.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN wi.state <> 'WAITING' THEN wi.state ELSE NULL END AS rejection_detail FROM alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = n.group_id LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = n.run_id LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease l ON l.run_id = n.run_id LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi ON wi.run_id = g.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = g.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = g.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = g.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = g.next_segment_sequence WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM notification_consumed) AS consumed, (SELECT count(*) FROM segment_promoted) AS promoted, (SELECT group_id FROM notification_consumed) AS group_id, -- 放行出来的那一段的完整身份随结果一起返回：周期补扫这一路手上只有通知， -- 拿不到身份就没法把下一段投给节点池，而为了拿身份再读一次库会和别的写入赛跑。 (SELECT run_id FROM segment_promoted) AS next_run_id, (SELECT plan_generation FROM segment_promoted) AS next_plan_generation, (SELECT node_id FROM segment_promoted) AS next_node_id, (SELECT node_attempt FROM segment_promoted) AS next_node_attempt, (SELECT segment_sequence FROM segment_promoted) AS next_segment_sequence, -- 取不成的那些：原因与补充状态一起带回去。 (SELECT rejection FROM diagnosis) AS rejection, (SELECT rejection_detail FROM diagnosis) AS rejection_detail

WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} AND g.run_id = r.id FOR UPDATE OF r ), group_stopped AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE g.id = #{groupId} AND g.state IN ('WAITING', 'READY') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.plan_generation, g.node_id, g.node_attempt, g.next_segment_sequence ), members_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'CANCELED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE m.group_id = s.id AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') RETURNING 1 ), segment_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE wi.run_id = s.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = s.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = s.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = s.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = s.next_segment_sequence AND wi.state IN ('WAITING', 'RESUMABLE', 'RUNNABLE') RETURNING 1 ), notification_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE n.group_id = s.id AND n.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM group_stopped) AS groups_canceled, (SELECT count(*) FROM members_canceled) AS members_canceled, (SELECT count(*) FROM segments_canceled) AS segments_canceled, (SELECT count(*) FROM notification_canceled) AS notifications_canceled
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'RUNNING', external_operation_id = COALESCE(#{externalOperationId}::varchar, m.external_operation_id), dispatch_proof_json = COALESCE(CAST(#{dispatchProofJson} AS jsonb), m.dispatch_proof_json), next_poll_at = COALESCE(#{nextPollAt}, m.next_poll_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.member_identity = #{memberIdentity} AND m.state = 'PENDING' -- 已经在库里的外部作业身份不能被另一个值换掉：整组落库时写下的身份是结果接收方 -- 找回这个成员的唯一凭据，派发阶段只能沿用同一个值。 AND (m.external_operation_id IS NULL OR #{externalOperationId}::varchar IS NULL OR m.external_operation_id = #{externalOperationId}::varchar) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = m.run_id AND r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion})

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member SET next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt}, poll_count = poll_count + 1, backoff_step = LEAST(backoff_step + 1, #{maxBackoffStep}::int), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity} AND state = 'RUNNING'
